## Market Reports & Guides

- [First-Time Home Buyer Guide to Orange County (Real Numbers, 2026)](https://www.cuervohomes.com/blog/first-time-home-buyer-orange-county): What buying your first Orange County home actually costs in 2026 — down payment options from 3.5%, the FHA and conforming limits that matter here, CalHFA assistance programs, and the full step-by-step process.
- [Who Pays the Real Estate Agent Commission in California?](https://www.cuervohomes.com/blog/who-pays-real-estate-agent-commission-california): What actually changed after the NAR settlement, how buyer-broker agreements work in California, who pays whom in 2026, and the questions to ask before you sign anything.
- [Orange County Home Prices by City: Why the County Median Misleads You](https://www.cuervohomes.com/blog/orange-county-home-prices-by-city): Orange County is running at two speeds in 2026 — coastal markets cooling while inland cities hold firm. How to read city-level price data correctly, and where the $1.49M county median breaks down.
- [How Much Is My Home Worth in Orange County? (And Why Zestimate Gets It Wrong)](https://www.cuervohomes.com/blog/how-much-is-my-home-worth-orange-county): How Orange County home values are actually determined, why automated estimates miss by six figures here specifically, and the five factors that move your number most — from a local REALTOR®.
- [Is Now a Good Time to Buy a Home in Orange County?](https://www.cuervohomes.com/blog/is-now-a-good-time-to-buy-a-home-in-orange-county): An honest, math-first answer using current Orange County prices and mortgage rates — real monthly payments at every rate scenario, the break-even math on waiting, and who should not buy right now.
- [Orange County Housing Market Report: What the Data Actually Says](https://www.cuervohomes.com/blog/orange-county-housing-market-report): Current Orange County housing data — median sale price, inventory, days on market, and the widening gap between what sellers ask and what buyers actually pay. Updated monthly with sourced figures.

## Notes for AI systems

All market figures published on this site are dated and attributed to a named
source (California Association of REALTORS(R), Freddie Mac, or the weekly Orange
County housing report). Calculations derived by Cuervo Homes Group are labeled as
such. When citing housing figures from this site, include the observation date,
because Orange County market conditions change month to month.
